title: Human-Imitating Metrics for Training and Evaluating Privacy Preserving Emotion Recognition Models Using Sociolinguistic Knowledge

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing saliency-based model explanations (using Integrated Gradients) to measure the attribution weights of sociolinguistically-informed, gender-correlated words. The study compares a baseline model with privacy-preserving models (trained via adversarial training, gender-swapped data augmentation, or bias fine-tuning) using a proposed Emotion-Privacy (EP) metric to quantify the avoidance of gender-indicative features, and validates this metric with crowdsourced human evaluations.
